Subject: DPA / SCCs: Order Form redlines and EU transfer impact — kickoff

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation Alder is ready to move forward pending a couple contract items: the DPA redlines, SCCs mapping for EU transfers, and confirmation of processor/processor roles on the Order Form.

I’ve attached a first-pass redline of Redwood’s standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_Redline_v1.docx) and an SCCs mapping sheet that maps vendor clauses to Alder’s template. High-level asks we heard from your side:
- Customer wants standard EU SCCs applied, with a narrow data transfer impact addendum for US-hosted logs.
- Procurement needs an explicit point of contact and a plan/timeline for evidence requests (SOC2, subprocessor list).
- Security wants clarity on roles (controller/processor/subprocessor) for the model training pipeline and logs retention.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick sync (30m) to walk the DPA redline and SCCs mapping — can you do Tue 10/6 10:00 or Wed 10/7 14:00 CET?
2) Internal coordination: loop in Legal and Security from Redwood for any technical clarifications.

Ben/ Irene — tagging you for the legal and security POV and to capture any immediate blockers before the call.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus —

Appreciate the materials. We reviewed the redline briefly with Legal and Security — a few immediate notes:
- Alder legal prefers the vendor-to-customer roles in the DPA be explicit (we need Processor obligations called out and a short delegation table for subprocessors).
- On SCCs: we require Appendix-style confirmation that SCCs will be executed with the Order Form (not an internal policy reference).
- Security requests confirmation on where logs are stored (EU region by default) and an assurance that KMS control for customer keys is possible for Private deployments.

We can do Tue 10/6 10:00 CET (that works for our team). Could you add Redwood Legal to the invite and prepare an annotated list of where your standard DPA diverges from the Alder template?

Sara
Sara Whitman
Deputy General Counsel | Alder Biotech

Marcus / Ben —

Saw the attachments. Quick internal notes before the call:
- I added inline comments in Redwood_DPA_Redline_v1.docx to flag two customer asks that are likely to be negotiation points: explicit subprocessor delegation matrix (we can offer an exhibit), and SCCs appendix wording (we typically attach SCCs as an exhibit and sign).
- For the logs/KMS ask: Private deployment supports customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) — but that will need an order form option (we should surface the impact to pricing).
- EU data residency: our hosted clusters can be pinned to eu-west-1; however, some operational logs (control plane) are replicated to the US for telemetry. We need to quantify retention and whether we can encrypt-at-rest with customer keys for those telemetry items.

I’ll prepare a short internal summary and evidence list (SOC2 report stub, subprocessor list export) for the call. Ben — can you confirm SLO/OrderForm language around dedicated capacity options? I want to make sure we call it out in the draft.

Irene
